verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Wrangler commands for deploying Workers, Bindings to connect services, and rollback to previous versions. Nothing in the pack documents a single configuration file that defines, deploys, and versions the whole architecture. Deploy commands and version rollback are related features, not the story's single-file capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can define, deploy, and version my entire architecture with a single configuration file
